title: Compatible lifting of finitely generated abelian group maps
statement:
Let $A,B,E,E_0,J$ be abelian groups, written additively, with $A$ and $B$ finitely generated, meaning finitely generated as $\mathbf Z$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] for their canonical integer scalar action. Let $u:A\to B$ be a homomorphism, put $K=\ker u$ and $C=B/u(A)$, and suppose $K$ and the torsion subgroup $C_{\mathrm{tors}}=\{c\in C:\exists n>0,\ nc=0\}$ are finite. Let
$$0\longrightarrow J\xrightarrow{i}E\xrightarrow{\pi}E_0\longrightarrow0$$
be an exact sequence, meaning $i$ is injective, $\pi$ is surjective and $\ker\pi=i(J)$. Suppose multiplication by $|K|$ and by $|C_{\mathrm{tors}}|$ are automorphisms of $J$; the order of the trivial group is $1$. Given homomorphisms $a:A\to E$ and $b_0:B\to E_0$ with $\pi a=b_0u$, there is a homomorphism $b:B\to E$ satisfying $bu=a$ and $\pi b=b_0$.

source.place: Agent-formulated abelian-group obstruction lemma for the chart-lifting argument of Kato (1988), Theorem 3.5, cited by Expose XVI Proposition 3.6.3, printed p.252.
